Interface HighlightRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
CsvHighlightRepository, InMemoryHighlightRepository, PostgresHighlightRepository
public interface HighlightRepository
Where highlights are kept between one request and the next. Every caller depends on this interface, never on a class that knows how the storage works.

There is no lookup by kind of play: the system does not classify plays.

  • Method Details

    • save

      void save(Highlight highlight) throws RepositoryException
      Stores a highlight, replacing any earlier one with the same id. A replaced highlight keeps its position: only a new id goes to the end.
      Parameters:
      highlight - the highlight to keep
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the highlight is null, or its id, camera id or clip path holds a comma or a line break. Every implementation refuses these, even one that could store them, so a highlight one repository accepts any other accepts too. That is bad input rather than a storage failure, so it is unchecked and never a RepositoryException, and nothing is stored.
      RepositoryException - if the storage cannot be written

    • rename

      void rename(String id, String title) throws RepositoryException
      Gives a stored highlight a new name, keeping its position and everything else it holds.
      Parameters:
      id - the stored highlight to rename
      title - the new name, checked by HighlightTitle
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is blank or spans more than one line
      RepositoryException - if no stored highlight has this id, or the storage cannot be read or written

    • delete

      void delete(String id) throws RepositoryException
      Removes a stored highlight. An unknown id leaves the storage as it was: the highlight is gone either way, so there is nothing to report.
      Parameters:
      id - the stored highlight to remove
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the storage cannot be read or written

    • findById

      Optional<Highlight> findById(String id) throws RepositoryException
      Looks up one highlight. An unknown id, or null, gives an empty result — never an exception.
      Parameters:
      id - the highlight to look for
      Returns:
      the stored highlight, or empty when none has this id
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the storage cannot be read

    • findAll

      List<Highlight> findAll() throws RepositoryException
      Every highlight, in the order first saved.
      Returns:
      the stored highlights, empty when nothing was ever saved
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the storage cannot be read; a CorruptedRecordException still carries the highlights that could

    • findByCourt

      List<Highlight> findByCourt(int courtNumber) throws RepositoryException
      The highlights of one court, in the order first saved.
      Parameters:
      courtNumber - the court whose highlights are wanted
      Returns:
      that court's highlights, empty when it has none
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the storage cannot be read; a CorruptedRecordException still carries the matching highlights that could
